reviews.text:
The people who work in the store are very nice, and the selection in the store is usually very good. Unfortunately, I have a very negative impression of the store manager. I recently learned that buddy is so-called member-owned and not typically chain-based. The general manager is the manager of Tveita og bøler, which only connects these stores together.
A few weeks ago I bought a rain cover from non stop for 1049,-. When I got home I discovered that my roommate had bought the same thing and had already used it. Two days later I go back to Tveita to return what I bought (unused, with tags on and receipt). Then I am told that they do not operate with open purchases unless this is agreed in advance. So I do not get my money back, but I am offered a credit card, which can only be used at Tveita og bøler. I explain that I am moving in 3 days and it will be a bit of a long journey. There is nothing else my dog ​​needs and the amount is so high that I explain that I will have to spend it on food/vomit, which can be demanding for me to transport as I am heavily pregnant (in the third trimester) with a long journey and without a car. The general manager cares very little about this, and although the fact that you can get the money back "if agreed in advance" indicates that he has full ability to refund, he does not want to find any solution that makes it easier for me.
I have sent an email complaining about the incident and explaining the situation to the general manager, as he was not there when I stopped by (I spoke to a nice but somewhat uncertain employee when I stopped by, who spoke to the general manager on the phone while I was in the store). He has not bothered to respond to that email and it has now been about a month since I sent it. I was not informed that they do not operate with refunds and there is nothing about it on the receipt.
Poor handling and very little service orientation. I will definitely not shop at Buddy again after this voucher is used up.
